primary_anchor_zh: 清楚分开的四只大型软垫
story_reason_zh: 软垫被拿去拍打除尘，随后放回阅览区

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 一组大型地面软垫在拱窗阅览室的空旷地板上，布面边缘被微风轻轻掀动。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 布面边缘被微风轻轻掀动
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 清楚分开的四只大型软垫占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 管理员缓慢推动装有四只软垫的低车离开阅览室；随后呈现空旷地板和拱形窗。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 管理员缓慢推动装有四只软垫的低车离开阅览室
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 管理员缓慢将装有四只分开软垫的低车推回阅览室地面
shot_design.main_action_zh: 管理员缓慢将装有四只分开软垫的低车推回阅览室地面
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 清楚呈现清楚分开的四只大型软垫；不要求复现精确排列。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames four large floor cushions, clearly separated from one another in an arched-window reading room. The edge of one cushion lifts gently.

A fixed wide shot shows four large floor cushions, clearly separated from one another in an arched-window reading room. An attendant slowly pushes a low cart holding all four floor cushions through the reading-room doorway and out of frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty reading-room floor and the arched window. The window curtain moves slightly.

A fixed wide shot holds on the empty reading-room floor and the arched window. An attendant slowly pushes a low cart holding four large separated cushions back into frame and stops it on the reading-room floor.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 管理员缓慢推动装有四只软垫的低车离开阅览室
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 管理员缓慢将装有四只分开软垫的低车推回阅览室地面
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
